Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fighting-game PROP ATLAS, one coherent sprite-sheet asset. Create a 1536x1024 landscape PNG with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND and exactly 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, 384x512 pixels per cell. Eight isolated theatrical prop arrangements, one per cell, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Every arrangement fully contained inside its cell with 36px transparent margins. No humans, no faces, no background, no floor, no labels, no text, no watermarks, no visible grid or cell borders. Consistent eye-level side/three-quarter view appropriate for a side-view arcade stage. Crisp dark ink outlines, detailed hand-painted cel shading, slightly exaggerated tangible Venezuelan arcade illustration, warm material texture, soft colored rim highlights, rich amber wood and saturated playful details. NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector icons, NOT isometric, NOT photorealistic. Each arrangement stands centered and isolated in its own cell. Object clarity at small game size is crucial. Seats clearly visible, table and chairs entirely visible, no people. Warm amber wood. This set is very important.
